TASK_ACK.contamination_disclosed: Before forming any judgement I read, as the contract's order of work requires, sections 4.1-4.2 of verifications/2026-09-13_aldaz_batch004_reexamination.md - the PRIOR VERIFIER's diagnosis and its two proposed wordings. This is unavoidable here and is not the ordinary Stage-1 contamination: OBJECT B *is* the application of those wordings, so the proposals are the object, not a peer's framing of it. The consequence I must hold against myself is the opposite of deference to a peer - it is the temptation to ratify a wording because a verifier supplied it. The contract states the rule I am applying instead: a repair that applies a verifier's own wording is still an unverified repair, and the wording is judged against the PRIMARY SOURCES, not against the proposal.
TASK_ACK.declared_bias: Toward finding a defect, because a verification that confirms everything reads as though it did no work - the exact pressure that manufactures a false positive against a true sentence. And, specific to OBJECT B, toward ratifying the applied clauses because a verifier authored them and the dispatcher applied them.

OBJECTIVE: Judge both objects against the SOURCES. OBJECT A: per-locator verdicts over all 24 verbatim locators (17 body / 7 figure), and an assessment of the coverage map behind the 9/9 evidentiary-panel declaration. OBJECT B: clause-by-clause judgement of the two applied repairs - are the wordings TRUE against the sources, do they UNDER-claim, and was anything true deleted; specifically whether the two-variable bound (stimulus AND compartment) is what the two papers support or an over-read, whether 'nei tessuti e sotto gli stimoli qui elencati' under-claims what the cerebellar and sepsis legs do show, and whether DL-REPO-002's therapeutic direction is still correctly IPOTESI with its drug unidentified.
WHY_IT_IS_ON_THE_CRITICAL_PATH: OBJECT A is the antecedent from which CLAIM 007's mechanism descends, so an error in it propagates into a consolidated-baseline claim; it carried 24 locators into the canonical state without ever having been the object of a dedicated verification. OBJECT B changed the two sentences that a reader consults for the direction of the whole neuroinflammation axis, and it changed them to text no one has checked against the primary. The mandate cannot close while either stands unverified.
THE_RULE_THAT_GOVERNS_THIS_TASK: 🔴 Every finding is checked against the source before it is reported. A true statement is NEVER called for deletion in order to obey a verification result - in this batch an earlier pass nearly deleted a true, audit-authored sentence by compression and was stopped. Overshoot is the common failure; UNDERSHOOT is the rarer and more dangerous one, and a silent narrowing is a defect exactly as an over-claim is. If a check returns EMPTY, the pattern is suspected before the text is concluded absent.
